Class Platform.Builder

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.platform.Platform.Builder
Enclosing interface:
Platform
public static final class Platform.Builder extends Object
Detects a Platform from its sources. Each source defaults to the running JVM's: SystemProperties.system(), Environment.system() and FileSystems.getDefault().

The operating system comes from the os.name property; any value not recognized as Linux, macOS or Windows is taken for another Unix-like system. Every path of the platform belongs to the file system.

      public Platform detect()
      Detects the platform from this builder's sources. The sources are read now; later changes to them do not affect the platform.
      Returns:
      the platform
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if os.name or user.home is not set
      InvalidPathException - if user.home, or an environment variable the platform reads a directory from, is not a valid path on the file system
